description.label: Description
description.value:
Minor Mental Mutation

Your intellect has pierced through the facade o existence and seen that its all a big, pointless joke - and you just cant stop laughing at the banality and futility of it all. Sure, you still make an eort to keep things interesting; setting goals, having ambitions and so on, but its all for sport at this point - trying to push the system and the players in it. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.8pVzgPkgWpTJvfhG]{Fearless} (All) Talent. Your Ambitions tend towards the erratic, involving things that, at least to you, challenge the illusion of meaning. Your humour deviates from social convention, and your maniacal laughter causes discomfort in others: you gain -10 Fellowship. You can only gain this mutation once.
